model_annotation: The plot labeled "(b) Loss Ratio w.r.t FLOPs" illustrates the Loss Ratio (%) with respect to TFLOPs for five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 1e8, with tick marks appearing to be regularly spaced at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with numerical tick labels at regularly spaced intervals of 1. A solid, horizontal gray line with square markers represents the "Vanilla" method, maintaining a constant y-value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis range. A solid orange line with right-pointing triangle markers, representing "SepLLM (n=64)", begins near a y-value of 94.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of approximately 99 near 6e7 TFLOPs, and then declines slightly to end roughly at 98 by 1e8 TFLOPs. A solid green line with circular markers depicting "SepLLM (n=128)" starts at approximately 95 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to roughly 99 by 5e7 TFLOPs, and maintains a steady trend to end near 99. A solid blue line with upward-pointing triangle markers for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" begins around 97, rises steadily to peak near 99.5 by 6e7 TFLOPs, and ends just below 100 at 1e8 TFLOPs. Finally, a solid red line with diamond markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" begins at approximately 99, maintains a relatively flat, steady trend with minor fluctuations near 99.5 throughout the visible x-axis, and ends roughly at that same value near 1e8 TFLOPs.
